uf90a19fe09: Support for custom UART upgrade was added in programmer version V3.1.8.
ude61c8f978: [1] Open the ⟦1⟧burner.exe⟦/1⟧ software and, in the main window of the programmer tool, click [File] (文件) -> [Deploy] (部署) -> [UART Upgrade] (串口升级) to open the main window of the UART upgrade deployment program, as shown in ⟦2⟧UART upgrade main window⟦/2⟧;
u6504d55545: [2] Define the corresponding IOs and the single-wire/two-wire mode in the application;

ub2b24db049: When programming AC521X chips with the 1-to-8 programmer, if the chip's KEY has not been programmed before, the following conditions must be met:
uef4e17fa45: [1] The four pins USB_VCC, USB_DM, USB_DP and GND must be connected;
u54a17d3af1: [2] If the chip is blank and no KEY file has been programmed, a 4.5V voltage must be supplied to the chip's PA13 pin during programming;
u5f30f20f24: [3] If the chip is not blank and a KEY file has already been programmed, there is no need to supply power to the PA13 pin during programming; you can upgrade the chip firmware directly through the USB connection;
u027194b6ad: Programming the KEY of a video chip for the first time generally requires an additional external voltage on a specific pin. Therefore, if you need to program a chip's KEY, it is usually more convenient to use the 1-to-2 programmer. The 1-to-8 programmer is generally used to upgrade the firmware of chips whose KEY file has already been programmed.
u14b09d0558: Blank AC791N/AC531N chips must first be programmed with the 1-to-2 programmer. You cannot program a FW file with a KEY directly with the 1-to-8 programmer, because the conditions for programming the KEY of this chip model are special. The 1-to-8 programmer currently blocks blank-chip programming of AC791N/AC531N and supports only reprogramming of the flash data.
u35422514c8: [1] To program a FW file with a KEY into a blank chip, you must use the 1-to-2 programmer.
u405f07c2af: [2] For reprogramming, where only the FLASH data is upgraded, you can use the 1-to-8 programmer, but you must at least confirm on one device that it powers on.
u7615d0802e: Blank AC792N chips can be programmed directly with either the 1-to-2 or the 1-to-8 programmer. The programming connections are usually VBAT, USB_DM, USB_DP and GND.
